scripts.types:generate: wrangler types pages-configuration.d.ts -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types probe-configuration.d.ts -c wrangler.probes.jsonc
scripts.types:check: wrangler types pages-configuration.d.ts -c wrangler.jsonc --check && wrangler types probe-configuration.d.ts -c wrangler.probes.jsonc --check
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run types:generate && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.build:check: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.pages:build: npm run build && wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/functions --project-directory . --build-output-directory dist --output-routes-path dist/_routes.json && node scripts/prepare-pages.mjs
scripts.pages:dev: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply atrinik-observatory-local --local -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply atrinik-observatory --remote -c wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run pages:build && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.probes.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.probes.production.jsonc && node scripts/validate-deployment.mjs
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name atrinik-observatory
scripts.deploy:production: npm run db:migrate:production && npm run deploy:pages && npm run deploy:probes && npm run verify:production
